svg.title: Zero-Trust Hierarchy authority and evidence flow
svg.desc: The Architect / Owner ratifies governing documents, the Orchestrator authorizes one bounded unit, the same human judges its return, and the Engineering Lead uses a replaceable Gauntlet Loop before returning evidence for receipt and disposition.
